Last week, I had the opportunity to participate in the Rebuilding Inclusion: An HR Equity Case Competition, where my team and I were proud to place 1st! 🏆 For this competition, we developed a Governance Toolkit designed to strengthen transparency, accountability, and equity across the employee lifecycle. Our solution focused on three key areas: Credibility & Language Repair in recruitment, Advancement Architecture redesign, and long-term Cultural Reinforcement through governance and accountability mechanisms. Through organizational analysis and structured governance strategies, we addressed gaps in promotion transparency, leadership representation, and psychological safety identified in the case. This experience was a great opportunity to apply strategic problem-solving, organizational analysis, and systems thinking to a complex HR challenge, while exploring how governance and leadership accountability can drive meaningful, sustainable change. Thank you to the judges and organizers for such a thoughtful and engaging case. And to my teammates Andy Gavane , Karina E. , and Sarah Joseph — I’m incredibly grateful for the opportunity to work alongside you. This win was made possible through your hard work and collaboration. ❤️ Congratulations as well to all the other teams who participated, I learned so much and had an amazing time throughout the competition. 😊 ...more ...more
